name: Procore Bid Management
summary: Bid creation, bid leveling, trade-partner prequalification and bid-to-subcontract conversion inside the Procore platform.
differentiator: Worth buying only as part of the wider Procore platform, where a winning bid converts straight into a subcontract or purchase order with budgets and contracts attached. Procore bills on annual construction volume, not on how many bids you run, so for a small GC it is one of the most expensive routes into bid management on this list.
pricing: Not published. Procore prices by annual construction volume. Third-party sources estimate $15,000 to $30,000 per year for contractors running $10M to $50M of work, with unlimited users and storage.
whoPays: GC pays; fee scales with annual construction volume, unlimited users
bestFor: Mid-size and larger GCs that want bidding connected to project financials.
skipIf: You only need bid invitations and comparison, not a full project platform.
